# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, so there is no build in which verification is turned off. This is paired with the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so no host, internal ones included, is served over plain HTTP, and every connection is subject to certificate verification.
EOF
